clues.text: In this city, a large Citgo sign overlooks Commonwealth Avenue.
This city’s Muddy River runs through Olmsted Park, a part of this city’s Emerald Necklace.
The southern border of this city is formed by the Neponset River, whose mouth lies between Quincy and Dorchester, the largest neighborhood of it.
The USS Constitution is docked near Logan International Airport in this city.
Frederick Law Olmstead designed this city’s Emerald Necklace, which includes a Common near this city’s Financial District.
This city’s Back Bay area is on the Charles River, across from its sister city, Cambridge.
Kenmore Square is connected by this city’s “T” system to Northeastern University and its namesake “Common.”
This city’s Back Bay contains the poorly-designed John Hancock Tower.
The Old State House and the Paul Revere House are sites on this city’s Freedom Trail.
Name this most populous city in New England, the capital of Massachusetts.
A chef from this state, Paul Prudhomme, popularized the turducken.
The salt dome and peppers grown in this state’s Avery Island were used to produce the first Tabasco sauce.
An estuary in the southeast of this state is crossed by the longest continuous bridge in the world.
A sandwich popularized by Sicilian immigrants in this state contains olive salad and is called the muffuletta.

Refugees of one ethnic group, deported in an event known as Le Grand Dérangement, eventually settled in this state’s Atchafalaya Basin. Acadiana is a French-speaking region in this state’s southern parishes.
Beignets and a type of coffee are sold at the Café du Monde in this state’s Decatur Street.
This state’s Avery Island is the traditional growing site of the peppers that make up Tabasco sauce.
Bourbon Street, which holds a big Mardi Gras celebration, can be found in the French Quarter of this state’s largest city.
Cajun influence is prominent in what state home to New Orleans?
Name this state which prominently features Creole and Cajun cuisine.

clues.text: Black specks characterize the PGI bananas grown on Fyffes plantations in this archipelago, whose port city of Arguineguin (“ar-GEEN-ee-GEEN”) has become an ad hoc camp for migrants.
Silbo is a whistled language spoken on this polity’s island of Gomera.
A Combre Vieja ridge here might cause a megatsunami if it collapses catastrophically.
Once called the Fortunate Islands by the Romans, they were created from the group of volcanoes which can still be seen at Pico de Teide on Tenerife.
In 1977, the worst accident in aviation history occurred when two Boeing 747s collided on a runway on its island of Tenerife.
The largest island in this group is home to Los Rodeos airport, the location of the deadliest aviation disaster in history; that island is Tenerife.
Half of this archipelago is governed by the province of Las Palmas.
Contrary to expectations, this island group derived its name from the local dog population and not from any kind of bird.
Name these Spanish islands in the Atlantic that are actually named for their dogs, not a type of bird.
Name this Spanish-held island group located just off the western coast of Morocco.
